SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-20-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-03-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506 PLAINTIFF JEFFREY OWENS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SERENA CHEN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ADRIAN CHEN IS PRESENT. PARTIES AGREE TO SETTLEMENT IN OPEN COURT. DEFENDANT ADRIAN CHENG WILL RETURN TO PLAINTIFF JEFFREY OWENS THE FOLLOWING ITEMS LISTED AS ATTACHED. DEFENDANTS TO PAY PLAINTIFF $150.00 TO COVER THE COST OF AIRFARE FROM LOS ANGELES TO SAN FRANCISCO AS WELL AS $75.00 FOR THE COST OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. PLAINTIFF OWENS RELINQUISHES AND WAIVES ANY CLAIM OF ITEMS HE MIGHT REMEMBER MISSING AFTER TODAY - APRIL 20, 2021. DEFENDANT'S CLAIM IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. PROGRESS REPORT HAS BEEN SET. AN APPEARANCE IS NOT REQUIRED IF THE TERMS OF THIS AGREEMENT ARE MET, IF NOT MET, AN APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED. IF NO APPEARANCE AT THE NEXT HEARING DATE, THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF DEFENDANT'S CLAIM WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF JEFFREY OWENS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SERENA CHEN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ADRIAN CHEN IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
